meta.notes: Layer 3 (inventory / BOM): (s, S) grids on the perishable pearls and the non-perishable tea kit, serial lead time, pearl shelf life, shelf-life x lot-size interaction, and lost-sale vs substitution. Baseline scenario data/scenarios/inventory_lean.json.
caveats: fill_rate divides by all arrivals (including the warm-up hour); the money and served metrics are post-warm-up. Morning stock-outs therefore appear in fill_rate but not in served.
purchase_cost charges every purchased unit including stock left at closing and re-charges the opening stock on every replicate, so it must be read next to fill_rate / stockout_losses.
waste_units is a lower bound: expiry is evaluated lazily when an ingredient is next touched.
A single outstanding order per ingredient (the engine's (s, S) rule), so an order quantity below the lead-time demand guarantees a stock-out.
